objective: Produce read-only, source-bound artifact/release plans that reject source, artifact, CI metadata, destination authorization, migration and recovery identity mismatches before any deployment effect.
nonGoals: No artifact build, mutation, upload, release, deployment, migration execution, rollback or hidden network activity
No claim that a local approval pin authenticates itself, that CI metadata alone establishes independently accepted source, or that this package grants deployment authority
No additions to protected GitHub workflows, required checks, repository rulesets, or other repositories
decisions: Release planning remains offline and declarative; a source-acceptance/approval identity supplied out of band is conditional until operator trust provisioning is independently authenticated.
Every approved migration/recovery plan is content-digest bound to the exact repository source revision; CI provider metadata remains advisory until separately verified.

obligations.description: Bind a clean exact Git commit/tree, candidate CI evidence and the separately approved source acceptance identity; reject wrong source, stale CI metadata or mutable plan inputs.
Hash artifact bytes independently and reject absent, oversized, symlinked or mismatched artifact source and pin.
Bind destination, operator identity, grant, expiry, and migration/recovery content digests; reject mismatched or expired authorizations.
Operate offline read-only, no code execution/target writes; output never misstates release or deployment authority, with repeatable Linux/Windows results.

structure: src/sf/release.py: closed release input schemas, source and artifact digest checks, external approval identity and deterministic plan output
src/sf/cli.py: read-only sf release plan CLI, explicit input surfaces
tests/test_release.py: synthetic clean Git source, independently derived byte digests and adversarial identity/tamper/expiry fixtures
docs/factory/SF14_RELEASE_PLAN.md: trust boundary and acceptance contract
impact: Introduces an offline release-planning boundary; no deployment authorization, command execution or target changes
Known project-owned migration/recovery and release approval inputs stay under explicit digest and authority boundaries

budget.network: No network from release planning; GitHub provider reads only for PR status
budget.execution: Focused source-bound local/test fixture checks; one stable hosted PR validation, reuse run evidence

externalEffects: No deployment, publication, installation into other repositories, release creation or settings changes
PR #25 stacked on PR #24 and held until cumulative PR #28 merge authorization
No new reviewer requirement or paid service
